Job Description: Senior Consultant - International Development

Position: Senior Consultant
Organization: International Development Consultants
Location: Nairobi, Kenya (Remote work acceptable)
Employment Type: Contract

Description:
We are seeking a Senior Consultant with expertise in international development to support our portfolio of projects across East Africa. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of designing and implementing development programs, managing stakeholder relationships, and delivering measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement development projects in East Africa
- Provide technical guidance to local partners and governments
- Monitor and evaluate project outcomes
- Prepare reports and presentations for donors and stakeholders

Required Qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in international development
- Advanced degree in development studies, economics, or related field
- Experience with World Bank, UN, or similar multilateral agencies
- Fluency in English; additional African language an asset
- willingness to travel up to 30% within East Africa

Preferred Qualifications:
- Previous experience in Malawi or neighboring countries
- Knowledge of results-based management
- Project management certification (PMP or equivalent)

Application Deadline: July 15, 2024

Interested candidates should submit their CV and a covering letter detailing relevant experience to applications@idcconsultants.example.com
